blocks.text: Glaiza De Castro announced that she and her family are selling their holiday home in Baler, Aurora, saying the decision was prompted by changes in their priorities and new plans for the future. The actress said this as she shared photos of the facade and interior of the two-story home through her Instagram page on Friday, Sept. 25.
